reason: Generates an OpenAPI 3.1 document from the live oRPC router for the Scalar interactive docs route.
maintenance: Part of the @orpc/* v2 beta family already adopted for the RPC layer; tracks the same beta.28 release as @orpc/server and @orpc/client.
provenance: Official @orpc/openapi package, resolved to the exact Bun lockfile artifact and integrity above.
alternatives: Hand-writing the OpenAPI spec would duplicate router metadata and drift; @orpc/openapi derives the spec from the live router so contract changes propagate automatically.
